EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Adam Jaskiewicz, resident, expressed concerns regarding the Arbor South Development Agreement. He also urged Council to promote more education regarding Vision Zero.

EventItems.EventItemTitle: Ryan Housekeeper - Public Summary of Proposed Arbor South Development Agreement (DC-2) (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Jeremy Haley, Ypsilanti Township resident, spoke about affordable housing and risks of private/public partnership.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Jeremy Haley - Public Summary of Proposed Arbor South Development Agreement (DC-2) (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Margaret McCall, resident, spoke about Vision Zero and the need to prioritize the $500,000 for quick build projects for safety.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Margaret McCall - Vision Zero priority and the spending of the $500,000 on major road safety improvements (phone)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Jirka Hladis, resident, spoke about Vision Zero. He spoke about an epidemic of traffic violence and urged Council to take action.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Jirka Hladis - Vision Zero (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Kirk Westphal, resident, urged Council to act on Vision Zero. He also spoke about an emergency safe speed resolution, stating the community overwhelming supports safety.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Kirk Westphal - Emergency Safe Speed Resolution (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Peter Houk, resident, spoke about the update provided by staff to the Transportation Commission. He stated the report was very disappointing and he disagrees with staff's assertion that Engineering can't fix the high-speed of drivers. He urged staff to retract the report.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Peter Houk - Transportation Commission Annual Safety Street Update (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Adam Goodman, resident, spoke about City staff's report to the Transportation Commission. He stated the staff report abdicated any responsibility for driver behavior and safety.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Adam Goodman - Vision Zero (Zoom)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Rachel Pooley, resident, was not present.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Rachel Pooley - Ann Arbor Land Trust (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Blaine Coleman, resident, urged Council to end military aid to Israel.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Blaine Coleman - We are against military aid to Israel (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Mark Scerbo, resident, spoke about transportation safety and the value of slower speeds for Vision Zero.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Mark Scerbo - Safe speed street design (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Mozhgan Savabieasfahani, resident, spoke about the deaths in Gaza. She stated the war in Gaza is a genocide.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Mozhgan Savabieasfahani - We are against military aid to Israel (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Pwon Bailey, resident, spoke about anxiety and housing insecurity.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Pwon Bailey - Life in Ann Arbor (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Kathy Griswold, resident, spoke about the City report that was provided to the Transportation Commission regarding Vision Zero. She stated it was not the fault of the one engineer, but the overall policies of the City as directed by City Council.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Kathy Griswold - Solutions to pedestrian safety crisis (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Abubaker Ibrahim, resident, spoke about the Building Department's zoning and permit process. He accused the City of fraudulent behavior.

A public hearing was conducted on the proposed Ordinance to Amend Chapter 40 (Trees and Other Vegetation) of Title III (Parks and Public Grounds) of the Code of the City of Ann Arbor. Notice of public hearing was published November 27, 2025.

EventItems.EventItemMatterName: 12/1/25 Resolution to Approve Townie Homes Brownfield Plan
EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote:
A public hearing was conducted on the proposed Resolution to Approve a Brownfield Plan for Townie Homes at 1780 and 1788 Scio Chuch Road, 225 and 235 South Wagner Road, 1535, 1563, 1565 and 1567 South Maple Road, and 1288 and 1369 Jewett Avenue. Notice of public hearing was published November 27, 2025.

Sarah Lorenz, representing the Ann Arbor Land Trust, spoke in support of the project.
Adam Jaskiewicz, resident, spoke in support.
Jeremy Haley, Ypsilanti Township, had questions regarding the Brownfield Plan process.
An essential worker from Michigan Medicine spoke in support.
Kathy Griswold, resident, spoke in support for the project and for essential workers.
Brian Chambers, of the Land Trust, spoke in support.
Peter Allen
Tom Stulberg
SarahEllen Strongman
Alex Lowe

There being no further comment, the Mayor declared the hearing closed.
